setup: Bench inside the rack, pins set first
Pin height at the point you want to train
Set up exactly as for your bench press
execution: Lower the bar under control to the pins
Let it settle; keep your body tight
Press up hard from the dead stop
Finish at straight arms over shoulders
faults: Don't drop the bar onto the pins
Don't relax your back at the bottom
Don't let your elbows flare out

notes: Check both pins are at the same hole and fully seated before loading the bar.
Do warm-up sets to confirm the pin height before going heavy.
The pins catch a failed rep from that height, but a spotter is still sensible for the lift-off and racking.
Wrap your thumbs round the bar. Avoid a thumbless grip.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
